description: Maintain a reliable history of medication changes and reasons.
notes: Inlined Kit fallback implements the full contract and is active by design; app runs standalone with zero console errors (Playwright-verified).

notes.note: 'Git log for your meds' is a lovely metaphor that nobody will pay $4/mo for. It's a ledger you consult twice a year; retention is structurally impossible on a subscription. This is a feature inside a pharmacy app or a caregiver product, not a standalone.
Ledger add with reason+interaction check; form validation works, zero errors.

notes.change: Doctor-visit handoff: one-page printable + copyable med summary (current meds, change log with reasons, interaction flags); fixed high-severity modal 'Log anyway' which never fired under the real kit; pill emoji -> SVG.
